STATE CLARIFICATION: Job PANELS selects Initial loading. Render that initial loading state only, without simultaneously rendering incompatible empty/feed-updated/error/end alternatives. Main header: 我的笔记, 收藏, 0 篇笔记 / 按最近修改排序. Source refresh icon must visibly be disabled while loading; 新建笔记 remains enabled. Main body shows six blank skeleton cards, source's 3-column desktop grid. No real cards, summaries, stars, more menus, load-more/footer or empty message while items are empty and loading. Sidebar remains the matching source collection context, active 收藏 rail item. Do not copy the baseline's nonloading state into this selected loading mockup. All listed important states remain contracts, not states simultaneously proven by this image.
FLAT STYLE CONTRACT: The first image is STYLE ONLY. Use source-owned DooKnow knowledge UI, no ToDoo task/goal controls. Flat #ffffff main and header, #f7f8fa context sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 border, #4566c6 primary, #edf1ff selected. Clean Chinese sans-serif, fine line icons, 8px corners; no paper texture, gradient, bevel, glow or illustration. Approximately 64px primary rail, 56px top global header, 260px contextual sidebar with its resize divider. Retain source owner rail O avatar, 笔记/最近/收藏/应用, bottom 回收站/设置. Retain sidebar search 搜索笔记与目录, split 新建, relevant collection list and its source controls. Keep source/role/state caption in separate outer margin only. Never draw source paths or protocol metadata in app UI.
